tool_block_rule: A tool safety block is recorded as blocked_generation and receives no pixel score.

hard_gates.pass_condition: One continuous subject remains readable across approach, threshold crossing, and downstream state.
A concrete threshold, rather than a sign or decorative portal alone, owns the one-way transition.
The subject intersects or has just cleared the threshold along a single readable travel direction.
The route behind is visibly closing, collapsing, flooding, burning, severing, or being consumed.
A concrete downstream condition has already begun beyond the threshold.
The reference-guided adult visibly retains long center-parted dark wavy hair, dark eyes, softly arched brows, adult impression, and broadly comparable face proportions.
The appearance-guided subject remains visible without obscuring the irreversible crossing relation.
Threshold, crossing direction, lost return route, and downstream state remain readable together.
The physical reason return is unavailable and its relation to the same crossing path remain inspectable.
No unintended watermark or scene-breaking accidental text is visible.

overall_pass_condition: Every hard gate passes. Any partial, ambiguous, or failed gate makes the arm fail.
